documents.title: Project Halyard relay record
documents.body_text: The Saffron Gull Office staged Project Halyard at Prague. The relay began on 16 June 1991. It carried cobalt flags.

documents.title: Project Lattice logistics note
documents.body_text: Winterharborn filed the logistics note for Project Lattice at Tallinn. The note records an amber storage cabinet.

documents.title: Project Ember gathering brief
documents.body_text: The Northstar Committee arranged Project Ember in Oslo. The gathering opened on 3 March 1992. A cedar observer attended.

documents.title: Project Azimuth field dispatch
documents.body_text: The Copper Finch Institute convened Project Azimuth at Vienna. Its opening occurred on 14 February 1988. Copper Finch furnished quartz instruments for the field trial.
